newsitem.title: ESTONIA: HOIUPANK PROFIT UP IN APRIL.
newsitem.headline: HOIUPANK PROFIT UP IN APRIL.

text.p: Hoiupank's net profit in April was 17.8 million kroons compared to 14.2 million kroons in March, it said on Monday.
The bank earned a net profit of 58 million kroons in the first four months of the year, it added in a statement.
The major revenue source was as usual interest revenues and service commissions, the bank said.
Hoiupank's net profit of 58 million kroons makes up more than half of its annual profit estimate of 113 million kroons.
Hoiupank's assets rose by 374.45 million kroons or 7.4 percent in April to 5.4 billion kroons.
On the liabilities side, deposits showed the biggest increase, to rise by 283.8 million kroons or 7.6 percent to 4.003 billion kroons.
The gross loan portfolio rose by 335.2 million kroons or 12.6 percent to 3.002 billion kroons.
